correctness.rationale: The paired-coordinate map is a bijection with exact center boundary and GC/Hamming weights. The coefficient transfer counts all constrained words once. Explicit alternating-track constructions achieve every asserted r; parity excludes the missing zero value for odd m. The stationary 16-state product Markov chain has eigenvalues yielding integrated covariance diag(1/4,15/64), with zero cross-covariance; explicit four-step return loops establish full lattice span and the Fourier local CLT. Separate direct and transfer enumeration agrees through m=5; exact moments and transfer agree through m=6; tests are corroborative, not infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Searches for complete aligned reverse-complement self-Hamming distance profiles with simultaneous exact GC balance and homopolymer avoidance found no statement implying the full all-length sixteen-state spectrum, sharp support and conditional Gaussian coefficient. Closest primary articles optimize constrained DNA codebooks. An indexed fixed-necklace result addresses the already-known zero-distance subcase; that subcase is expressly excluded as an independent novelty claim. Residual risk of unindexed or unpublished equivalences remains.
residual_risks: Indexed fixed-necklace source was only available as title/summary and its full text could contain a more general enumerator; no whole-document NOT_COVERING assertion is made.
Broader algebraic weight-enumerator literature could contain an equivalent transfer representation under different terminology.
The asymptotic fluctuation law uses a standard finite-state Markov additive local limit theorem, not an independently externally refereed probability proof.

value.rationale: Aligned self reverse-complement distance is the single-strand exclusion statistic underlying strand-orientation screening and lower bounds for RC-separated DNA libraries. Precisely GC-balanced no-homopolymer words are a natural design population; the complete all-length distance profile, exact admissible support and Gaussian scaling are needed to quantify the fraction of available candidate words at any chosen threshold, rather than merely the familiar self-complementary count. The result is not claimed to solve codebook optimization or full molecular hybridization.
